# WaveFern Records

> WaveFern Records is a free 3D open-world music career sim in your browser. Create a character, record songs and albums in your studio, release them on Spotifly and grow your fame, then explore a big open-world 3D city on foot or by car, buy houses, cars and clothes, and meet other artists. No download.

WaveFern Records is a fictional 3D open-world browser game built with Three.js (plain JavaScript, no install). Real artists named in-game are inspiration references only, with no affiliation or endorsement.

## Links

- [Play the game](https://wavefern.github.io/WaveFern/): the live game
- [Version history](https://wavefern.github.io/WaveFern/versions.html): player-facing changelog
